summary: Citizens of the United States, Canada, Australia, New Zealand, the countries of Europe, Brazil, Russia, China, Japan, South Korea, Singapore, Malaysia, Indonesia, Brunei, Turkey, Egypt and the Gulf states can obtain a 30-day visa on arrival (US$50 plus processing fees) at Bangladesh's international airports and land ports, at the immigration officer's discretion, while other nationalities, including Indian citizens, apply for a visa through a Bangladeshi mission, starting on the official portal visa.gov.bd. The immigration police say citizens of Barbados, Bhutan, Fiji, Ghana, Grenada, Jamaica, Saint Kitts and Nevis and Trinidad and Tobago need no visa for stays of up to 90 days.

passportValidity.text: The UK Foreign Office says your passport must be valid for at least 6 months after the date your visa starts, and that a Bangladeshi visa starts on its date of issue, not on your date of travel. It also says the passport needs at least 2 blank pages and no damage.

vaccinations.name: Yellow fever
vaccinations.text: A yellow fever vaccination certificate is required of travellers aged 1 year or over arriving from a country with risk of yellow fever transmission, or who transited through an airport in one — however short the transit.

travelInsurance.text: No official source we could read states a travel insurance requirement for Bangladesh. The UK Foreign Office advises having travel insurance that covers local treatment and unexpected medical evacuation.

onwardTicket.text: Visa-on-arrival travellers may be asked for a return ticket, among the documents the immigration officer examines before granting the visa, under Bangladesh's Visa Policy 2026.

tips.text: For the visa on arrival, carry the fee (US$50, excluding processing fees, in cash) and be ready to show a hotel reservation, a return ticket and proof of finance. The UK FCDO says you must have a return ticket and proof of funds, and that officers issue the visa at their discretion.

The UK FCDO warns that political rallies, demonstrations and strikes (hartals) can quickly turn violent, with arson and vandalism in towns and cities. Stay away from protests and large gatherings, and move to a place of safety if one starts.
The Government of Canada says the monsoon runs from June to October and seriously affects a third of the country each year, making roads impassable, and that the coastline is subject to cyclones.

The UK FCDO advises against all but essential travel to the Chittagong Hill Tracts (Rangamati, Khagrachari and Bandarban districts). Canada's travel advice says that if you go, you must contact the Chittagong Divisional Commissioner's Office at least 10 days before you arrive.

The UK FCDO advises men and women to dress modestly, and women to cover their shoulders and legs in public. During Ramadan it advises following local dress codes and checking the opening hours of shops and restaurants.

faq.question: Do I need a visa for Bangladesh?
faq.answer: Citizens of the US, Canada, Australia, New Zealand, the countries of Europe, Brazil, Russia, China, Japan, South Korea, Singapore, Malaysia, Indonesia, Brunei, Turkey, Egypt and the Gulf states can obtain a 30-day visa on arrival for US$50 plus processing fees. Other nationalities apply through a Bangladeshi mission, starting online at visa.gov.bd, where the fee schedule lists the fee for each nationality. The immigration police say citizens of Barbados, Bhutan, Fiji, Ghana, Grenada, Jamaica, Saint Kitts and Nevis and Trinidad and Tobago need no visa for stays of up to 90 days.

faq.question: How does Bangladesh's visa on arrival work?
faq.answer: Eligible travellers pay the fee (US$50, excluding processing fees) in cash at the Sonali Bank counter at the port of entry, for a single-entry stay of up to 30 days. Under the Visa Policy 2026 the immigration officer grants the visa after examining documents such as a hotel reservation, a return ticket and proof of finance in card or cash.

faq.question: Can I extend my stay in Bangladesh?
faq.answer: Yes. The UK FCDO says you can apply for a visa extension from the Department of Immigration and Passports.

faq.question: Do Indian citizens need a visa for Bangladesh?
faq.answer: Yes. The immigration police (Special Branch) eligibility checker says Indian citizens must obtain a visa from the nearest Bangladeshi mission, and India is not among the nationalities named in the visa-on-arrival list of the Visa Policy 2026.

faq.question: Is Bangladesh safe to visit?
faq.answer: The UK FCDO says terrorists are very likely to try to carry out attacks in Bangladesh, that political demonstrations and strikes can turn violent, and that road accidents are common. It advises against all but essential travel to the Chittagong Hill Tracts.
